title: Partnership: work with Creative Rein
description: Partner with Creative Rein near Bath: group sessions, visits, joint events and new ideas with our horses and ponies.

sections.heading: Partnership
sections.lede: We love working with people who share our values. If you'd like to partner with Creative Rein, we'd be glad to hear from you.

image.alt: Three horses eating from buckets outside the stables

sections.heading: Who we work with
sections.body:
We're open to ideas from schools, home-education groups, wellbeing practitioners, local businesses, charities and community organisations.

It might be a regular group session, a one-off visit, a joint event or something we haven't thought of yet. Tell us what you have in mind.

image.alt: Cathy and Charlie smiling with their arms around each other in front of the stables

sections.heading: Share your skills with the community
sections.intro: Do you have something you'd love to share? We're always happy to hear from people who want to teach, run a workshop or bring something new to our community.

items.title: Teach a class or workshop
items.text: Art, crafts, music, outdoor skills, yoga or anything else you love. Run a one-off session or a regular class in our countryside setting.

items.title: Run a wellbeing session
items.text: Mindfulness, movement, nature walks or quiet time with the horses, for children, grown-ups or both.

items.title: Host a community event
items.text: A seasonal gathering, a talk, a family day or a fundraiser. We can help you plan it around the horses and ponies.

items.title: Something else entirely
items.text: If you have an idea that brings people together, we'd love to hear it.

sections.heading: Tell us about your idea
sections.intro: Choose "Partnership or working together" in the form, and tell us a little about your organisation.
